question: Why was it necessary to use a very thin gold foil ($~10^{-7} \text{ m}$) in the Geiger-Marsden experiment?

options.A: To ensure that alpha particles undergo only a single collision as they pass through.
options.B: To make the nucleus visible under a microscope.
options.C: To ensure the gold atoms do not vibrate.
options.D: To increase the probability of head-on collisions.
